title: Oridonin Suppresses Bladder Cancer Growth and Metastasis by Inducing S-Phase Arrest and Apoptosis.
snippet: Bladder cancer (BC) remains a major clinical challenge owing to limited therapeutic options and high recurrence rates. Oridonin (ORI), a natural diterpenoid derived fromplants, exhibits promising anti-tumor activity, but its effects and mechanisms in BC remain poorly defined.
